# dsh-standing-rules
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that appends the rules from `AGENTS.md` to every incoming user message as
Harness plugin that appends the rules from `AGENTS.md` to every incoming user message as a reminder.
- Each incoming user message gets one reminder message right after it, so the model reads the rules

next to the latest message.
- Reminder messages stay in the conversation history and accumulate as t

he conversation grows.
- Reads the rules file when the reminder is built; edits take effect on the n

ext message.
- Adds no tools, commands, or UI.

## Behavior
- Every incoming user message, including a task message delegated to a subagent, gets one reminder m

essage appended right after it.
- The reminder is a user-role message with a `<system-reminder>` fra

me containing the file verbatim; a literal `</system-reminder>` inside the file is escaped.
- The fi
le is read once per incoming message. A missing default file adds no reminder; an explicitly configu

red file that cannot be read fails the request.
- Each reminder stays in the conversation history an
d costs its input tokens on every later request. Long conversations accumulate copies by design.
